name: Dengue
description: A viral infection transmitted mainly through the bite of infected Aedes mosquitoes.
warning_signs: Bleeding from the gums or nose
Extreme weakness, restlessness, or pale/cold skin
prevention: Avoid mosquito bites, especially during the daytime.
Use mosquito repellent and protective clothing.
Remove stagnant water where mosquitoes can breed.
when_to_seek_medical_care: Seek medical care immediately if warning signs of severe dengue occur.
critical_safety_notes: Do not diagnose the disease from symptoms alone.
Do not provide individualized medication or dosing instructions.
Escalate severe or emergency symptoms to professional medical care.
response_restrictions: Do not state that the user has this disease based only on symptoms.
Do not prescribe medication or dosing.
Use prevention and care-seeking guidance and cite the source.

name: Tuberculosis (TB)
description: An infectious bacterial disease caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis. It most commonly affects the lungs and can spread from person to person.
prevention: Seek medical attention for prolonged cough or other TB symptoms.
People at increased risk should follow recommended screening.
People with TB should follow infection-control guidance such as covering their mouth when coughing and maintaining good ventilation.
when_to_seek_medical_care: A prolonged cough, fever, weight loss, or other suspected TB symptoms should be evaluated by a healthcare professional.
higher_risk_groups: People with weakened immune systems, including people living with HIV
critical_safety_notes: Do not diagnose the disease from symptoms alone.
Do not provide individualized medication or dosing instructions.

name: Rabies
description: A viral disease that can be transmitted through the saliva of infected animals, commonly through bites or scratches.
common_symptoms: Abnormal sensations or pain around a wound
prevention: Avoid contact with unfamiliar or potentially rabid animals.
Vaccinate dogs and other animals according to veterinary/public-health recommendations.
Wash bite or scratch wounds thoroughly with soap and water.
Seek medical care immediately after a potentially risky exposure.
when_to_seek_medical_care: Any potentially rabies-exposing bite or scratch should be assessed urgently by a healthcare professional.
higher_risk_groups: Children are frequent victims of dog-mediated rabies exposure
People with occupational or personal activities involving potentially infected animals

Do not provide individualized medication or dosing instructions.

name: Japanese Encephalitis
description: A viral disease transmitted mainly through infected mosquitoes. It can cause inflammation of the brain.
prevention: Vaccination is an important prevention method in areas where Japanese encephalitis vaccination is recommended.
Use mosquito nets and repellents where appropriate.
when_to_seek_medical_care: Fever accompanied by confusion, seizures, severe neurological symptoms, or altered consciousness requires urgent medical attention.
higher_risk_groups: People living in or travelling to areas with endemic transmission
